snippet.title: Invariant | Devlog #1 | Introduction & Origins
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692380/Invariant/?beta=0
Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/P7dUSJzgDq

Invariant is a survival horror FPS inspired by the shooters and horror classics of the ’90s and 2000s. 
After a catastrophic incident cuts the Antarctic research facility off from the outside world, an increasingly desperate fight for survival begins.
Combining atmospheric horror with intense first-person combat and logical puzzles, Invariant blends exploration, tense firefights, and resource management into a constant struggle for survival.
As you delve deeper into the disaster, layers of secrecy and failed experiments begin to reveal that the catastrophe is far more complex than it first appeared.
